item.title: v2.0.0 (macos)
item.description:
FCMS Pro is now **Lancy**. Same local-first app, new name, new look, and new tools for getting paid.
### Added - **Invoice PDF**: export a client-ready invoice from any commission page, with your business details, the job, payments received and the balance due. - **CSV export**: save clients, commissions, payments and expenses as spreadsheet files from the Backup page. - Sidebar version badge with a one-click "Check for updates". - Your existing FCMS Pro data (database, attachments, backups) is copied into Lancy automatically on first launch. The old install is left untouched.
### Changed - New brand: Lancy logo, app icons, installers and website. - Redesigned sidebar with grouped sections and a clearer active-page indicator; softer corners and spacing across the app. - Updates now come from the new Lancy release feed and are signed with a new key. Install this version manually once; later updates are automatic.
### Fixed - The active sidebar item was unreadable in the Light theme. - Saving a backup now offers a JSON file type instead of PDF.
